scenarios.title: Complete three-listing evidence
scenarios.given: A prepared Bela Vista property with three source listings, nine reasons and two dated reductions.
scenarios.when: Open the actual Property detail from filtered Search.
scenarios.then: Every price, source, event, interval, reason and feature is consistent with the parsed real API, and no Sale or unavailable image is fabricated.

scenarios.title: Identity and safe manual failure recovery
scenarios.given: Malformed/v4 identities, an absent v7 identity, and a bounded injected HTTP failure.
scenarios.when: Open each state, manually retry the real detail, then return through history with a stale cache and a bounded refetch fault.
scenarios.then: Invalid identities cause no detail read, unknown context stays neutral, 404/errors expose no private body, known detail survives refetch failure, and manual retry reaches the real API without automatic retry.
scenarios.journey: Identity and safe manual failure recovery
